title: baseline_record.v2
description: Complete five-file baseline capture, descriptive analysis, and private record outcome. Stored-byte verification does not authenticate the producer or approve claims. Null published_record means no identity was returned, not proven absence. Runtime owns cross-field identity equality. Incomplete capture emits standalone evidence_error.v1 on stderr.

evidence_result.title: evidence_result.v2
evidence_result.description: Artifact-scoped descriptive evidence with separate producer-version claim, applied reader and owner-declaration byte identity; no decision authority.

source.description: Null only when no source identity can be established. Producer version is a declaration or unknown, not authenticated by this contract.

manifest_raw_hash.description: Raw bytes of a bundle manifest. Its hash alone does not establish that member bytes match the manifest, or authenticate the producer.

members.description: Each unique role names one member's raw-byte hash. Duplicate JSON keys must be rejected during decoding before schema validation.

producer_version.description: A source-declared package version or null; not authenticated.

reader_profile.description: Applied local reader rule, not producer version; null if none.

verification.description: Scoped assertions only. Consumers must resolve and reperform evidence_ref; schema-valid entries do not establish producer authentication or independent review.

declaration_source.description: One separately captured owner declaration, if supplied. Its hash identifies bytes but does not authenticate the owner or declared meaning.

observed_count.description: Number of parsed source records in the declared unit, including records whose outcome is missing or errored. This is not a count of successful measurements.

evidence_error.title: evidence_error.v1
evidence_error.description: Invocation or input failure of an evidence pilot command. No successful report was emitted. This is not a measurement verdict.

record_error.title: record_error.v1
record_error.description: Finite records command failure without caller-supplied diagnostics.

record_verification.title: record_verification.v1
record_verification.description: Stored-byte and direct-link integrity findings; valid false is result data, not invocation failure.

findings.description: At most one deterministic P2 runtime-selected finding per file or direct link; runtime precedence owns coordinate uniqueness.
